summary: Elevate your NGO's fundraising efforts with our comprehensive training course on crowdfunding and digital fundraising strategies.
lede: Crowdfunding and Digital Fundraising for NGOs helps you build a clear digital fundraising strategy instead of exploring online platforms without a defined plan. You will learn to choose suitable platforms, design campaigns, and turn interest into donations rather than likes and shares. The course shows you how to use authentic storytelling, multimedia, community engagement, and clear impact updates to connect with modern donors. It also covers performance measurement and ongoing optimisation, giving you practical, repeatable systems for raising more with limited staff, time, and budgets.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who regularly raise funds, design campaigns, or engage supporters in NGOs and nonprofits.
audience: Fundraising and resource mobilization officers in NGOs
modules: Fundamentals of Crowdfunding and Digital Fundraising for NGOs
Defining Your Campaign Strategy and Funding Goal
Selecting Platforms and Tools for Crowdfunding and Online Giving
Storytelling and Content Creation for Digital Fundraising
Designing High-Converting Campaign Pages and Donor Journeys
Driving Traffic: Social Media, Email, and Community Outreach
Compliance, Trust, and Donor Stewardship Online
Developing Your Digital Fundraising Action Plan
prerequisites: Participants should have basic knowledge of NGO operations and fundraising practices. Familiarity with digital tools and social media platforms is beneficial but not required.
